connector.name: Kresmion
connector.registryDescription: Prediction markets, on-chain flows, ETF flows, equities and macro intelligence for AI agents.
connector.summary: Hosted at kresmion.com over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.kresmion, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer krm_... Kresmion API key (free at https://kresmion.com/settings/api-keys)
